x-yogabase-authority: This document is written in this SDK repository from the agreed build-ingest contract while the Yogabase product repository implements it. It is not a mirrored product snapshot and it is not authoritative. When the product publishes docs/api/yogabase-builds-v1.openapi.json, that document supersedes this one and this file is deleted rather than reconciled.

info.title: Yogabase Build Ingest API (planned)
info.description: Control Plane build ingest. A developer tool hands Yogabase one build; Yogabase derives the layout manifest and a CycloneDX inventory, scans the inventory against a digest-pinned OSV snapshot, and signs manifest, inventory and scan together with the installation admission key. This surface carries no cloud, Kubernetes, fleet, or application credential, and it is not reachable with a player token.

controlPlaneHost.description: The installation's Control Plane origin. This is a different origin from the application gateway.

post.summary: Upload one build bundle and start its Build check.
post.description: The bundle is a zip. A client writes every metadata field before the bundle part so a server reading the form as a stream can refuse a malformed port or executable before buffering the archive.

get.summary: Read one build and the state of its Build check.
get.description: Poll every three seconds with backoff until the state is terminal. A refused build is a successful read, not an error: its findings and refusals are the answer.

developerToken.description: A project-scoped developer token issued from the console's Settings page and hashed at rest server-side. It is a secret: it belongs in a credential store, never in source control or a shipped client build.

BuildId.name: buildId
BuildId.description: Opaque build identifier returned by the upload. A client treats it as a bounded token rather than parsing it.

BuildAccepted.description: The bundle was accepted and its Build check has started.

Build.description: One build and its check result.

Problem.description: RFC 7807 refusal carrying a stable code.

executable.description: Path of the executable inside the zip, for example Server.x86_64. Optional; Yogabase derives it when the bundle carries exactly one candidate.

ports.description: One repeated field per declared port, in name=port/protocol form.

check.description: Absent while the state is checking.

BuildCheck.description: A pass means no Critical/High finding among the catalogued components in the pinned snapshot on its recorded date. It is never a claim that the build is secure: nothing is executed, statically linked and dlopen-ed libraries are opaque, and anything uncatalogued is reported as uncatalogued.

id.description: Advisory identifier, for example a CVE or GHSA id.

entry.description: Bundle entry the catalogued component came from.

BuildRefusal.description: A structural refusal names the first failing field or bundle path, so a corrected build can be re-uploaded.
